DARV.title: Darv
DARV.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACTER.0-: Oh my, a rare guest! You're not a puppet in this tower—you're a... 'Master'? From Chaldea? I heard you have a ton of treasures over there too!
Something like that. We're restoring the Human Order, and we've collected quite a few things along the way.
A collector! A fellow collector! Come, come, look at this pile of forgotten gems! Pick any one, take it!
DARV.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACTER.1-: You're back? How's the Human Order restoration going? I still have plenty of treasures!
DARV.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACTER.2-: Human Order Foundation? That's not easy to find... but I have a stone here, said to have fallen from a pruned world.
A pruned world... What happened to the people in it?
Hmm... forgot. Anyway, it's all in my collection. You want it? If not, I'll put it back. ...Fine, take one. At least someone still remembers it. Come again, Master!
NEOW.title: Neow
NEOW.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACTER.0-: Did you bring me back? Or is this place also some kind of Singularity?
NEOW.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACTER.2-: The Architect... is he at the top of the tower too?
[sine]...Go... I will... be... where you... look back...[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.title: Nonupeipe
NONUPEIPE.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACT: Oh my! Look who it is! A little Master, climbing all the way from distant Chaldea to me!
Hello. I'm Ritsuka Fujimaru, Master of Human Order restoration.
Human Order? Restoration? Sounds exhausting. Come, let me bless you and dress you up beautifully!
How dull. But... you have the light of Command Spells, and the shadow of Servants. Very well, I'll grant you a gift.
A cloak that will remind you 'someone is waiting for you' when you're in despair. Wear it and keep going.
Don't thank me yet. When you reach the top, you might find it was all worthless. ...Whether it's worth it, I'll decide when I get there.
OROBAS.title: Orobas
Puppet puppet!! Climbed all the way here?! Not a puppet? Then you're a 'Master'! Long name, can't say it!
You and the shield girl, climb climb, from morning to night!!
Yeah, we're climbing this tower. Have you seen many people like me?

Many many!! Blue balls, scythe hands, iron cans!
You're different! You have lots of stories around you! Tell one, tell one!!
So scary!! But so interesting!! Continue continue!! What happened next? Next!!

Shiny shiny!! Good, here's a gift! Take it, take it!
The Architect is bad, very bad! Don't listen to him! Neow is bad too!
Find more shiny things, then come back and tell more stories!! More!!
Later, he became our comrade. He loves shiny things.
Good! Good! Then it's settled: I keep listening to stories, you keep climbing the tower!!
PAEL.title: Pael
PAEL.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACTER.0-: Sorry to disturb your sleep. I'm Ritsuka Fujimaru, just passing through.
[thinky_dots]Passing through... or trapped...? You smell heavy... the smell of many people...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACTER.1-: [thinky_dots]Take a part of me... a bit of flesh that won't rush you... so you can keep walking...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACTER.2-: [thinky_dots]Because... you're too tired... I can tell... you're rushing even in your dreams...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]Then take it... and... keep sleeping... keep walking...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.title: Tanx
TANX.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACTER.0-: [b]Stop!! You look strong!! Come, fight me!![/b]
I'm not here to fight. I need to go to the top of the tower, to find the Architect.
[b]The Architect? That guy deserves a beating even more!! But you fight me first!![/b]
TANX.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACTER.1-: [b]Servants? Good!! Call them out!! I want to see your weapons!![/b]
TANX.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACTER.2-: [b]A shield!! Good shield!! But not enough!! Again!![/b]
We're not here to settle a score with you. We just want to get through.
[b]Hmph!! Boring!! But you have courage. Here, take a weapon!! Go give the Architect a beating!![/b]
TEZCATARA.title: Tezcatara
TEZCATARA.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACT: Oh my, little cutie, you're burning up. Is it flames, or Command Spells?
Both, I guess. We're restoring the Human Order, and we've burned quite a few things along the way.
Burn? [jitter][b]Burn[/b][/jitter]! I like that word! Come, let me burn away your weakness!
What a stubborn child. Fine, then taste the snack I made. It cools slowly, and you wait slowly.
Empty and hungry are very similar. Come, take a bite. Then keep walking, until the bitterness fades.
I'm not hungry. I'm just... a little empty.
...Thank you. I'll carry this bitterness to the end.
THE_ARCHITECT.title: The Architect
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHA: You've come. An anomaly from Chaldea.
Architect. You built this tower, looped countless lives, just to maintain your so-called order?
Order requires a price. You are one of those prices.
Strength doesn't matter. What matters is that you will never reach the end.
...Foolish. But you are noisy. Noisier than all those puppets.
Noisy because someone is waiting for me to return. Mash, Chaldea, and everyone who entrusted their future to me.
Then come. Let me see if your future can survive in this tower.
VAKUU.title: Vakuu
VAKUU.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACTER.0: Ah... Master of Chaldea. How many contracts have you signed? With Servants, with the Human Order, with the world?
Many. But I've never signed one with a demon like you.
Then why not try? I can give you power, so you never lose anyone again.
VAKUU.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACTER.1: The price? Simple—you can never stop. Forever fighting, forever summoning, forever watching others die for you.
VAKUU.talk.FGO_CHARACTER_FGO_CHARACTER.2: The difference is, you'll get used to it. Then you'll fall in love with the pain.
I refuse. My pain is not a commodity; it's the reason I keep walking.
A pity. But it doesn't matter. You'll come back eventually. After all, you always need more power. ...If I need it, I'll get it with my own hands and my comrades. Goodbye, demon.
